scope: Two complete candidate HOB cards: Master's Councillors and Great Gilded Boat, entirely using accepted typed engine mechanics

cards.name: Master's Councillors
obligations: Source gets +2/+0 per graveyard containing at least seven cards
Both own and opposing graveyards contribute independently, and bonuses disappear dynamically when counts fall
Controller second draw each turn triggers once, including during opponent turn; first and third draws do not trigger
Any player can be targeted to mill exactly three; captured trigger survives source departure
cards.implementation: StatValue::Sum of two AtLeast(Count graveyard, cards_only=true, minimum=7) values with controller-relative relations 0 and 1, one Source ScalingModifier of +2/+0, ordinary CardDrawn ordinal=2 and targeted Mill(3)

cards.name: Great Gilded Boat
obligations: Costs 2U and is initially a noncreature artifact Vehicle
Crew 2 chooses only own creatures and requires total power at least two
Actual crew payment taps both one-power creatures; animates to 4/4 until cleanup
Whenever controller attacks recruits once per declaration, regardless of Boat attacking or being a creature
An empty attack declaration does not recruit
Recruit draws before mandatory private discard; land gives no token, nonland gives a 1/1 white Human Soldier

shared_contracts: No new owned state, choices, quantities or events: existing central actual/speculative StatValue evaluation, Crew, Recruit, targeting and draw-event capture are reused. New tests prove this definition wiring and affected outcome boundaries.

first_run.reason: Opponent-turn test attempted next cast before active opponent passed priority. Fixed test helper to pass priority legally; no card or engine change.

throughput.scope: Two candidate complete cards; isolated branch creation to final focused terminal report, including authoring and shared build-slot waits

acceptance: Independent nonauthor reviews, full release validation and complete-set game acceptance remain with final integrated whole-set PR. No intermediate PR or merge was created.
